latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Bump actions/setup-go from 3 to 6 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/112
* Bump docker/login-action from 2 to 4 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/121
* Bump pnpm/action-setup from 2 to 6 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/117
* Bump actions/checkout from 3 to 6 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/116
* fix: increase request header buffer size by @anguscloud in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/123
* #109 add base_url feature by @mms-gianni in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/110
* Refactor gzipMerge function to simplify code logic and remove unnece… by @mms-gianni in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/128
* Bump docker/build-push-action from 3 to 7 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/125
* Bump docker/setup-buildx-action from 2 to 4 in /.github/workflows by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/114
* docs: add Simplified Chinese README translation by @whtis in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/130
* Release/v0.0.23 by @mms-gianni in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/127

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/112
* @anguscloud made their first contribution in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/123
* @whtis made their first contribution in https://github.com/everywall/ladder/pull/130

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/everywall/ladder/compare/v0.0.22...v0.0.23
